title: CargoMetadataProjection
description: Deterministic projection of `cargo metadata --format-version 1` written to the bundle as `cargo_metadata.json` for every cert/record bundle, and on the development profile when boundary.toml enables `forbid_build_rs` or `forbid_proc_macros`. Verify-time replays the boundary checks against the cached `packages` projection so a build.rs / proc-macro added between generate and verify is caught (LLR-072); the `dependencies` map binds the resolved dependency graph the baseline produced (LLR-141). Byte-stable across hosts: packages sort by name, the dependency map and its value sets are BTree-ordered (SYS-003).

packages.description: Flat projection of every package cargo metadata reports, sorted by `name` ascending — the subset the verify-time boundary recheck reads.

targets.description: Targets the package declares. Empty array is legal (some workspace metadata-only crates).

kind.description: Target kind discriminator from cargo metadata. Common values: ["lib"], ["bin"], ["custom-build"] (build.rs), ["proc-macro"], ["test"], ["bench"], ["example"]. The verify-time recheck keys on `"custom-build"` and `"proc-macro"`.

links.description: Value of the package's `links` field (e.g. "libz") if it declares a native library binding, otherwise omitted/null. Surfaced informationally in `BOUNDARY_FORBIDDEN_BUILD_RS` diagnostics so auditors see native-FFI hints without re-running cargo metadata.

dependencies.description: The RESOLVED dependency graph (not the declared dependency specs), projected from cargo metadata's `resolve.nodes`: each resolved package's `"name version"` identity maps to the sorted, deduplicated set of `"name version"` identities it depends on. Every resolved package appears as a key, including packages with no dependencies (empty array), so the key set is the full resolved package set.
